title: TS-68 Handoff step 4: infrastructure for the computer owner
description:
Source: the Pi session handoff spike (PR 474: spikes/pi-handoff, docs/PI_HARNESS.md section 'Spike: handoff to a computer owner', GO in steps) and docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md. Decision (user): the goal is a Pi session running in the computer container, using Pi's own tools (read, write, edit, bash from @earendil-works/pi-durable/tools), with the session portable between owners. Security gate before production: the container must not hold the model key or broad storage credentials.

CDK: the owner task role and the scoped role, the gateway route or Lambda, a take-over job on the start queue (the starter passes tenant, bot, channel and turn to the container), the OpenAI key never in the container, the old host-protocol claim path left in place until the cutover. Deploy through the repo workflows only. Then a live rehearsal on development (the user's go for each image push and task start).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live rehearsal on development, 2026-10-09, owner runtime on. Stage 1 smoke PASS (owner task definition, uid 2000, 32 s post to answer, spend recorded through the gateway, clean exit). Stage 2 security PASS (shell env has no secrets, cannot read the owner environ, no sudo or su, writes limited to /workspace and /tmp, metadata endpoint returns no credentials, credentials path variable absent from the shell env). Stage 3 recovery PASS: second owner took over after the first was stopped; the lost tool is reported, not re-run (designed). Stage 4 git bug fix PASS: 12 of 12, committed, persisted to a fresh owner on a new channel. Two earlier live failures found real policy gaps (ConditionCheckItem, then the MB# mailbox key), fixed in PRs 484 and 485 with a request-recording policy coverage scenario. Used 4 owner starts in stage 4 against a budget of 3. Left behind in the integration-test tenant: test bots, channels and files (ok, pwned, proj). Findings: owner logs only have owner_outcome lines; disk_dirty stays true after a read-only run (no publish when content is unchanged); the session policy has 30 characters of headroom under the 2048 STS limit.

right_now_summary: The development rehearsal passes smoke, security, recovery, and Git tests; two policy gaps were fixed.
